verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS like Raygun, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a Raygun CLI. It only references APIs (Deployments API, source map upload via API) and an MCP server, which are developer building blocks or a different story's capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
